sources.title: Kempsey Shire Council resignation notice
sources.supports: Noel Selby resigned effective 4 November 2026. Council said the vacancy would proceed to a by-election.

sources.title: Kempsey Shire Council current roster and by-election date
sources.supports: The Council banner confirms 16 January 2027. The published roster lists eight officeholders including Deputy Mayor Arthur Bain, and omits Noel Selby.

observations: Kempsey Shire Council reported Noel Selby’s resignation effective 4 November and confirmed a one-seat by-election for Saturday 16 January 2027. Council’s current directory lists eight officeholders, including Deputy Mayor Arthur Bain. The countdown uses the Sydney calendar date. Nomination deadlines and voting hours await an official timetable.
